title: Explain how to record a valuation allowance and report deferred taxes

items.concept: Initial recognition of DTA and valuation allowance; subsequent VA measurement schedule; period-end adjusting JE to reassess realizability; settlement when DTA reverses; single noncurrent net presentation of deferred taxes
Number-variant twin — recompute gross DTA/DTL/VA, combined tax JE, period-end VA plug to new percent unrealizable, net noncurrent presentation, and VA release when realizability improves fully
Standalone period-end adjusting JE for valuation allowance when gross DTA is already recorded; classify single noncurrent net deferred tax asset vs liability
Classification / presentation — single noncurrent net deferred tax asset or liability after offsetting DTA net of VA against DTL
Period-end adjusting JE — increase in valuation allowance increases income tax expense
